compatibility_note: Add serviceapi and shared pinned transport; optional explicit set_bandwidth resize parameters preserve prior rates when omitted and require bounded directional Mbps. Existing requests retain their canonical bytes. Commit ba52445794c44105fdb61c7b6d2bf6dde7277d26 adds an optional bcrypt password_hash credential for delayed reinstall setup. A later change adds an optional ssh_public_keys array (up to ten unique keys) alongside the existing single ssh_public_key, and relaxes reinstall/reset_password to accept at least one credential — a password or password_hash (still mutually exclusive with each other) combined with one or more SSH keys — instead of exactly one. The single-key and array forms are mutually exclusive in one request. Omitting ssh_public_keys preserves existing canonical request bytes.
